# HolyPlace

> Devotional chants across traditions — aarti, mantra, chalisa, and prayer, in the original script with English translation, plus guides on meaning, benefits, and festivals. Routes are statically prerendered, so non-JS crawlers see real content, not just this file.

- [Home](https://holyplace.vercel.app/): Grid linking to every tradition.
- [Guides](https://holyplace.vercel.app/blog): Meaning, benefits, and how-to guides across every tradition.
- [About](https://holyplace.vercel.app/about): What this site is and isn't.

## Hinduism

- [Hinduism overview](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism): Aarti, mantra, and chalisa for the deities.
- [Ganesha](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/ganesha): Remover of Obstacles. Chants: Mantra, Shloka, Aarti.
  - [Ganesha Mantra](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/ganesha/mantra): Mantra for Ganesha, "गणेश मंत्र", Devanagari with English translation.
  - [Vakratunda Mahakaya Shloka](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/ganesha/vakratunda-shloka): Shloka for Ganesha, "वक्रतुण्ड महाकाय श्लोक", Devanagari with English translation.
  - [Jai Ganesh Aarti](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/ganesha/aarti): Aarti for Ganesha, "जय गणेश आरती", Devanagari with English translation.
- [Shiva](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/shiva): The Auspicious One. Chants: Mantra, Mantra, Aarti.
  - [Shiva Mantra](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/shiva/mantra): Mantra for Shiva, "शिव मंत्र", Devanagari with English translation.
  - [Mahamrityunjaya Mantra](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/shiva/mahamrityunjaya): Mantra for Shiva, "महामृत्युंजय मंत्र", Devanagari with English translation.
  - [Om Jai Shiv Omkara](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/shiva/aarti): Aarti for Shiva, "ॐ जय शिव ओंकारा", Devanagari with English translation.
- [Vishnu](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/vishnu): The Preserver. Chants: Mantra, Shloka, Aarti.
  - [Vishnu Mantra](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/vishnu/mantra): Mantra for Vishnu, "विष्णु मंत्र", Devanagari with English translation.
  - [Shantakaram Bhujagashayanam](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/vishnu/shantakaram): Shloka for Vishnu, "शान्ताकारं भुजगशयनम्", Devanagari with English translation.
  - [Om Jai Jagdish Hare](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/vishnu/aarti): Aarti for Vishnu, "ॐ जय जगदीश हरे", Devanagari with English translation.
- [Lakshmi](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/lakshmi): Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity. Chants: Mantra, Gayatri Mantra, Shloka, Aarti.
  - [Lakshmi Mantra](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/lakshmi/mantra): Mantra for Lakshmi, "लक्ष्मी मंत्र", Devanagari with English translation.
  - [Lakshmi Gayatri Mantra](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/lakshmi/gayatri): Gayatri Mantra for Lakshmi, "लक्ष्मी गायत्री मंत्र", Devanagari with English translation.
  - [Namastestu Mahamaye](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/lakshmi/namastestu): Shloka for Lakshmi, "नमस्तेस्तु महामाये", Devanagari with English translation.
  - [Om Jai Lakshmi Mata](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/lakshmi/aarti): Aarti for Lakshmi, "ॐ जय लक्ष्मी माता", Devanagari with English translation.
- [Durga](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/durga): The Invincible Mother. Chants: Mantra, Gayatri Mantra, Shloka, Aarti.
  - [Durga Mantra](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/durga/mantra): Mantra for Durga, "दुर्गा मंत्र", Devanagari with English translation.
  - [Durga Gayatri Mantra](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/durga/gayatri): Gayatri Mantra for Durga, "दुर्गा गायत्री मंत्र", Devanagari with English translation.
  - [Ya Devi Sarvabhuteshu](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/durga/ya-devi): Shloka for Durga, "या देवी सर्वभूतेषु", Devanagari with English translation.
  - [Jai Ambe Gauri](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/durga/aarti): Aarti for Durga, "जय अम्बे गौरी", Devanagari with English translation.
- [Saraswati](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/saraswati): Goddess of Knowledge and Arts. Chants: Mantra, Vandana, Aarti.
  - [Saraswati Mantra](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/saraswati/mantra): Mantra for Saraswati, "सरस्वती मंत्र", Devanagari with English translation.
  - [Ya Kundendu Tushara Haradhavala](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/saraswati/vandana): Vandana for Saraswati, "या कुन्देन्दु तुषारहारधवला", Devanagari with English translation.
  - [Jai Saraswati Mata](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/saraswati/aarti): Aarti for Saraswati, "जय सरस्वती माता", Devanagari with English translation.
- [Hanuman](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/hanuman): The Devoted Protector. Chants: Mantra, Aarti, Chalisa.
  - [Hanuman Mantra](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/hanuman/mantra): Mantra for Hanuman, "हनुमान मंत्र", Devanagari with English translation.
  - [Aarti Kije Hanuman Lala Ki](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/hanuman/aarti): Aarti for Hanuman, "आरती कीजै हनुमान लला की", Devanagari with English translation.
  - [Hanuman Chalisa](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/hanuman/chalisa): Chalisa for Hanuman, "हनुमान चालीसा", Devanagari with English translation.
- [Krishna](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/krishna): The Divine Charioteer. Chants: Mantra, Gita Shloka, Aarti.
  - [Krishna Mantra](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/krishna/mantra): Mantra for Krishna, "कृष्ण मंत्र", Devanagari with English translation.
  - [Bhagavad Gita 2.47](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/krishna/gita-2-47): Gita Shloka for Krishna, "भगवद्गीता २.४७", Devanagari with English translation.
  - [Aarti Kunj Bihari Ki](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/krishna/aarti): Aarti for Krishna, "आरती कुंजबिहारी की", Devanagari with English translation.
- [Kali](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/kali): The Fierce Mother of Time and Transformation. Chants: Mantra, Dhyana Shloka.
  - [Kali Mantra](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/kali/mantra): Mantra for Kali, "काली मंत्र", Devanagari with English translation.
  - [Karalavadanam Dhyana Shloka](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/kali/dhyana-shloka): Dhyana Shloka for Kali, "करालवदनां ध्यान श्लोक", Devanagari with English translation.
- [Parvati](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/parvati): Daughter of the Mountains, Mother of the Universe. Chants: Mantra, Shloka.
  - [Parvati Mantra](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/parvati/mantra): Mantra for Parvati, "पार्वती मंत्र", Devanagari with English translation.
  - [Sarvamangala Mangalye](https://holyplace.vercel.app/hinduism/parvati/sarvamangala): Shloka for Parvati, "सर्वमंगलमांगल्ये", Devanagari with English translation.

## Sikhism

- [Sikhism overview](https://holyplace.vercel.app/sikhism): Bani from the Guru Granth Sahib.
- [Waheguru](https://holyplace.vercel.app/sikhism/waheguru): The Wondrous Lord. Chants: Mool Mantar, Japji Sahib, Ardas.
  - [Mool Mantar](https://holyplace.vercel.app/sikhism/waheguru/mool-mantar): Mool Mantar for Waheguru, "ਮੂਲ ਮੰਤਰ", Gurmukhi with English translation.
  - [Japji Sahib — Pauri 1](https://holyplace.vercel.app/sikhism/waheguru/japji-pauri-1): Japji Sahib for Waheguru, "ਜਪੁਜੀ ਸਾਹਿਬ — ਪਉੜੀ ੧", Gurmukhi with English translation.
  - [Ardas — Closing Prayer](https://holyplace.vercel.app/sikhism/waheguru/ardas-closing): Ardas for Waheguru, "ਅਰਦਾਸ", Gurmukhi with English translation.

## Christianity

- [Christianity overview](https://holyplace.vercel.app/christianity): Prayers to Christ and the Blessed Mother.
- [Jesus Christ](https://holyplace.vercel.app/christianity/jesus): Son of God, the Good Shepherd. Chants: Prayer, Psalm.
  - [The Lord's Prayer](https://holyplace.vercel.app/christianity/jesus/lords-prayer): Prayer for Jesus Christ, "Pater Noster", Latin with English translation.
  - [Psalm 23 — The Lord Is My Shepherd](https://holyplace.vercel.app/christianity/jesus/psalm-23): Psalm for Jesus Christ, "Dominus Regit Me", Latin with English translation.
- [Virgin Mary](https://holyplace.vercel.app/christianity/mary): Mother of God. Chants: Prayer.
  - [Hail Mary](https://holyplace.vercel.app/christianity/mary/hail-mary): Prayer for Virgin Mary, "Ave Maria", Latin with English translation.

## Buddhism

- [Buddhism overview](https://holyplace.vercel.app/buddhism): Refuge, mantra, and sutra of the Awakened One.
- [Buddha](https://holyplace.vercel.app/buddhism/buddha): The Awakened One. Chants: Refuge Formula, Mantra, Sutra Mantra.
  - [Tisarana — The Three Refuges](https://holyplace.vercel.app/buddhism/buddha/trisarana): Refuge Formula for Buddha, "त्रिशरण", Devanagari with English translation.
  - [Om Mani Padme Hum](https://holyplace.vercel.app/buddhism/buddha/om-mani-padme-hum): Mantra for Buddha, "ॐ मणि पद्मे हूँ", Devanagari with English translation.
  - [Heart Sutra — Closing Mantra](https://holyplace.vercel.app/buddhism/buddha/heart-sutra-mantra): Sutra Mantra for Buddha, "गते गते पारगते", Devanagari with English translation.

## Guides

- [Benefits of Chanting the Hanuman Chalisa](https://holyplace.vercel.app/blog/hanuman-chalisa-benefits): What the Hanuman Chalisa is, how it's traditionally recited, and the benefits devotees associate with chanting it daily.
- [Benefits of Chanting the Ganesha Mantra](https://holyplace.vercel.app/blog/ganesha-mantra-benefits): The meaning of "Om Gam Ganapataye Namah," how and when it's traditionally chanted, and why it's associated with new beginnings.
- [Om Namah Shivaya: Meaning and Benefits](https://holyplace.vercel.app/blog/om-namah-shivaya-meaning): The meaning behind one of Hinduism's most chanted mantras, how it's used in practice, and its place in Shaiva tradition.
- [Mantras to Chant Before an Exam](https://holyplace.vercel.app/blog/mantras-for-exams): Which mantras are traditionally chanted for focus, confidence, and calm before exams — and how to use them.
- [How to Celebrate Diwali: A Lakshmi Puja Guide](https://holyplace.vercel.app/blog/diwali-lakshmi-puja-guide): What Diwali is, why Lakshmi puja is central to the festival, and how it's traditionally observed.
- [Navratri: The Nine Nights and Nine Forms of Durga](https://holyplace.vercel.app/blog/navratri-durga-guide): What Navratri celebrates, the nine forms of Durga associated with each night, and how the festival is observed.
- [The Mool Mantar: Meaning of Sikhism's Opening Prayer](https://holyplace.vercel.app/blog/mool-mantar-meaning): The meaning and significance of the Mool Mantar, the opening verse of the Guru Granth Sahib and the foundation of Sikh belief.
- [What Is Ardas? The Sikh Prayer of Petition](https://holyplace.vercel.app/blog/ardas-meaning): What Ardas is, when it's recited, and the meaning of its closing lines on collective well-being.
- [The Lord's Prayer: Meaning and History](https://holyplace.vercel.app/blog/lords-prayer-meaning): The origin of the Lord's Prayer, its structure, and the meaning of its central petitions.
- [The Hail Mary: Meaning and Origins](https://holyplace.vercel.app/blog/hail-mary-meaning): The origin of the Hail Mary prayer, its two-part structure, and its place in Catholic devotional practice.
- [Om Mani Padme Hum: Meaning of the Buddhist Mantra](https://holyplace.vercel.app/blog/om-mani-padme-hum-meaning): The meaning and significance of Om Mani Padme Hum, one of the most widely recognized mantras in Buddhism.
- [The Three Refuges: What Is Ti-Sarana in Buddhism?](https://holyplace.vercel.app/blog/three-refuges-meaning): The meaning of the Three Refuges (Buddha, Dhamma, Sangha) and why taking refuge is foundational to Buddhist practice.
- [A Beginner's Glossary: Common Words in Devotional Chanting](https://holyplace.vercel.app/blog/glossary-devotional-terms): Plain-language definitions for mantra, aarti, chalisa, puja, and other terms used across every guide on this site.
